summary: Required courses must be letter graded where a letter grade is offered. You take the three first-year core courses (ESS 305, 306 and 307) and one course in each of the three distribution areas, for 135 graduate units with your research. Your advisor checks the 3.0 GPA, the four letter-graded graduate courses of at least 3 units from four different faculty, and the three first-year graduate courses from two ESS faculty; petitioned area courses are moved in by hand. The department records annual reviews, the two TA quarters, the qualifying exam, the oral exam and the dissertation.
